iron__from__ice_: Walter Ice was a fisherman in Northwick until the posters went up. He came to S-F7 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it, and within a day the whole bay knew that he is superstitious about the number three.
Walter Ice's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
Walter Ice found a clean patch on the table and put his bread on it. Someone immediately asked to borrow the patch.
